purpose: Make PGN metadata acquisition executable without guessing current API parameter names and without crossing the protected target-data boundary.

implementation.reason: The current review environment can inspect the public Swagger index but cannot directly navigate arbitrary API subpaths; the code therefore discovers the live OpenAPI parameter contract in a normal network environment before any exact query is reviewed.

nextSafeTransition.step1: Run --describe in a normal network environment and hash the returned OpenAPI document plus the four endpoint parameter descriptions.
nextSafeTransition.step2: Review and freeze the exact current parameter names needed to identify Izaña Pandora209 s1/s2 calibration, operation, file identity and metadata records.
nextSafeTransition.step3: Only then enable exact metadata queries; keep /v1/download forbidden.
nextSafeTransition.step4: Instantiate the already-frozen complete metadata-universe contract from those metadata-only results.
